sources.label: Official Bershka UK product-page size guide, Body measurements (cm), Boxy long sleeve T-shirt
Same body measurements on Raglan long-sleeve T-shirt

audit: Old /gb/help/size-guide-c1010193020.html 404s; no standalone guide found. Product-page 'See measurements' panel, BODY in cm, identical on two men's tops: XS-XL, 'Bust measurement' (stored as chest) and 'Hips measurement' (same value printed for both). XS 84/70 -> 87; M 92/78 -> 99; XL 103/89 -> 111. Waist removed (not printed); XXL removed (not offered); UK/US/EU removed (not printed).
